top_papers.abstract: Recent multi-agent LLM systems increasingly combine heterogeneous models for specialized agent roles. top_papers.title: Benchmarking and Enhancing Skill-Level Memory for Partially Observable Robotic Manipulation
top_papers.abstract: Recent advances in robot learning have enabled manipulation policies to perform increasingly diverse tasks and generalize across environments. However, reliable execution often depends on hidden task states that cannot be determined from current observations alone, making interaction history essential. top_papers.abstract: Streaming world models should render a place consistently across repeated visits. Directly supervising such revisits requires training samples that capture both visits, often spanning minutes. top_papers.title: DataMagic: Authoring Data Videos through Declarative Multi-Agent Orchestration
top_papers.abstract: Data videos communicate data insights through dynamic charts, voice narration, and synchronized animations, and have become a widely adopted form of data storytelling. However, producing them requires expertise in data analysis, narrative design, and video editing.
